# AI-data-map

A client-side System-1 workflow executor whose first use case is Quebec Law 25 data mapping.

- Repo: https://github.com/movahedi-ca/AI-data-map
- Tool (EN): https://movahedi.ca/tools/data-mapping-guide/assistant/
- Tool (FR): https://movahedi.ca/fr/outils/guide-cartographie-donnees/assistant/
- License: MIT
- Status: in-browser executor shipped (Phase 6), visibility stack in progress (Phase 7), October 2026

## What it is

Answer four intake questions in the browser and AI-data-map builds a draft Law 25
privacy inventory canvas step by step, with a narrating step log and a one-tap
confirm-or-fix loop on every auto-placed node. One click downloads a draft Excel
inventory; one click wipes the session. Every output is a draft for human review,
never a compliance verdict and never legal advice.

## Architecture (four layers)

- Chatbot: the mouth. Asks four questions, builds the recipe from deterministic
  templates. Zero LLM tokens in v1. Never executes.
- MCP: the nervous system. `execute_mapping_workflow(recipe)` validates the recipe
  and returns a session ticket.
- Tools: the muscles. The mapping-guide canvas, the Excel importer, the exporter.
- System-1: the reflexes. A typed-token transformer (~1.2M params) over the state
  snapshot that picks the next action from a versioned action catalogue. Runs
  locally via onnxruntime-web.

The planner writes the recipe. The executor does the clicking.

## Where things live

- Frozen specs (Phase 0): https://github.com/movahedi-ca/AI-data-map/tree/main/specs
  (recipe language, token encoding, state snapshot schema, action catalogue,
  retention rule; see specs/recipe-schema.json, specs/RECIPE-VOCABULARY.md,
  specs/SAMPLE-RECIPE.json, specs/RETENTION-RULE.md)
- Executor API reference: https://github.com/movahedi-ca/AI-data-map/blob/main/web/executor/EXECUTOR-API.md
- Model card: https://huggingface.co/movahedi-ca/s1-workflow-tiny
- Dataset card (scripted Playwright teacher, zero-token synthetic data):
  https://huggingface.co/movahedi-ca/ai-data-map-teacher
- Training scripts and eval harness: https://github.com/movahedi-ca/AI-data-map/tree/main/training
- Vendor knowledge base (~100 classified SaaS tools, verified retention ranges):
  https://github.com/movahedi-ca/AI-data-map/tree/main/vendor-kb

## Key guarantees

- Client-side only. No server inference, no telemetry, no accounts, zero
  third-party scripts.
- Outputs are drafts for review: done-heads emit "verify" flags, checks surface
  flags and never declare a mapping compliant.
- Retention values are ranges only, never single numbers, each citing the actual
  statute plus an as-of date.
- Training data comes from a scripted Playwright teacher (zero tokens), trained
  on free CPUs, published to Hugging Face under MIT.
- Eval targets: 95%+ task success on held-out synthetic orgs, 90%+ length
  generalization, 90%+ unseen vendor combos, 85%+ recovery after injected wrong
  actions, under 5 ms per action in-browser.
